title: dryopteris maximowiczii
intro: Dryopteris maximowiczii, commonly known as the Japanese golden-pleated fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris maximowiczii include wound healing, anti-cancer activities, and the regulation of blood pressure. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
